You never really know who you can trust. You can run an entire match with someone and then they kill you when you go to escape together xD I had a random give me a snap hook blueprint the other day and I was waiting for the other shoe to drop but he was just a nice guy with a legendary blueprint to give I guess. I usually play with my duo and we usually have a healthy mix of pvp and pve. I can see myself playing this game for a while. Wayyyyyy better than Dead by Daylight :P

I purchased this game because someone told me there are PvE lobbies. Turns out, with action based matching, that's not always true. I never kill another player, I never loot players, and I never attack back when I am attacked. Still, I get matched with people who kill me on sight, as per game design. It sucks when this happens. Most of the time I meet people who are very nice and even willing to help out but it's those moments where someone decides to be aggressive that ruin this game for me, especially right as I'm about to leave an expedition. The expeditions themselves are great fun but had I known that PvE lobbies were not a real thing, I would not have purchased the game. I play with my son, who I convinced to buy the game when I did, so my hours will keep increasing but I will not recommend this game in the current state it's in.

A wonderful game, a wonderful atmosphere, and amazing graphics!
Every time you start the game, it’s definitely a unique, standalone story that can end in a new friendship or an unexpected betrayal.
I’ve never experienced the emotions this game gave me anywhere else.
You decide exactly what kind of player you want to be. You can be a hero who saves and helps others, or a ruthless villain who doesn’t care who he kills. You decide for yourself who to trust and who not to, who deserves to die and who deserves help. The freedom of choice this game offers is what creates these incredible emotions and adventures.
I’m not afraid to say that it’s one of my all-time favorite online games.
The only thing missing is a Ukrainian localization, and I hope they’ll add it eventually, as promised.

love(d?) this game. 200+ hours played.

But making the amount 5 million for 5 skill points at expedition and not informing players about it until 2 weeks before the expedition window let all the air out of the balloon for me.

There are multiple reasons this sucks. But one of the big ones is that it makes the final stretch of the game, before the expedition, into a boring grind fest with gear fear and death fear.

Let’s say you already have 2 million and need to grind the last 3 million. That means you can’t spend anything of what you have, while selling more or less everything you loot for several weeks. If you manage 100% survival rate with no money spent and sell stuff worth 25 000 per raid, that’s 120 raids to reach the remaining 3 million. That’s 60 hours if you stay most of the raid and a little bit of downtime in between.

Unless they change this part of the cycle/part of the gameplay loop to something more fun and engaging, I can’t give this game a positive review.

Why not have bonus skill points accumulate through normal progression, attached to quest chains and project milestones? In that way the player would secure the points and still be able to spend their gear and money at the end of a wipe cycle to actually have some fun.
